title: The Full Body Forge
author: Bhavin S.
desc: Unleash your potential with The Full Body Forge, an 18-week program designed to sculpt and strengthen your entire physique. Committing to five days a week, you’ll engage in a balanced mix of resistance training and functional movements that target all major muscle groups. This program emphasizes progressive overload, ensuring you build strength and endurance while enhancing your overall fitness. Get ready to forge a stronger, more resilient you!
